provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: My amazing body
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to name body parts.
The pupils should be able to identify bones and muscles.
Introduction:
Today we learn about our amazing body.
Our body helps us play and work every day.
Content:
Our body has bones like strong sticks.
Bones hold us up. Muscles help us move.
The heart pumps blood. Lungs help us breathe.
Let's touch our bones. Feel your arms and legs.
Class activity:
Body systems puzzle game.
Children put together body part puzzles.
Evaluation questions:
What holds us up?
What helps us move?
What does the heart do?
Summary:
Our body is amazing with bones muscles heart and lungs.

topics.title: Nutrition plate
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list go grow glow foods.
The pupils should be able to build a healthy plate.
Introduction:
We eat food to grow strong.
Today we learn about healthy food.
Content:
Go foods give us energy like rice and yam.
Grow foods help us grow like beans and fish.
Glow foods keep us healthy like oranges and carrots.
We need all three groups on our plate.
Class activity:
Build my healthy plate game.
Children sort food pictures into go grow glow groups.
Evaluation questions:
What are go foods?
What are grow foods?
What are glow foods?
Summary:
A healthy plate has go grow and glow foods.

topics.title: Food groups
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify food groups.
The pupils should be able to sort foods correctly.
Introduction:
Food helps us grow big and strong.
Today we learn about different food groups.
Content:
Carbohydrate gives us energy like rice and bread.
Protein helps us grow like beans and chicken.
Vitamins keep us healthy like mango and spinach.
We need all groups for good health.
Class activity:
Sort my meal activity.
Children sort food pictures into carbohydrate protein vitamin groups.
Evaluation questions:
Which food gives energy?
Which food helps us grow?
Which food keeps us healthy?
Summary:
We need carbohydrate protein and vitamins for good health.

topics.title: Cooking is science
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list kitchen safety rules.
The pupils should be able to follow cooking steps.
Introduction:
Cooking food makes it tasty and safe.
Today we learn about cooking science.
Content:
When we cook beans porridge water gets hot.
Beans become soft after cooking.
Kitchen safety rules include washing hands.
We keep away from hot pots and fire.
Class activity:
Watch beans porridge being made.
Children observe and smell the cooking process.
Evaluation questions:
What happens to beans when cooked?
Why do we wash hands before cooking?
What must we keep away from in the kitchen?
Summary:
Cooking changes food and we must stay safe.

topics.title: Exercise and heart
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain how exercise helps the heart.
The pupils should be able to do simple exercises.
Introduction:
Our heart works all day to pump blood.
Exercise makes our heart strong and healthy.
Content:
When we play our heart beats faster.
Exercise makes our heart stronger like a muscle.
After play our heart rate slows down.
We should exercise every day for good health.
Class activity:
Heart rate after play.
Children run in place then feel their pulse before and after.
Evaluation questions:
What happens to your heart when you play?
Why is exercise good for us?
How does exercise help the heart?
Summary:
Exercise makes our heart strong and healthy.

topics.title: Posture and spine
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to demonstrate good posture.
The pupils should be able to identify back friendly habits.
Introduction:
Our spine helps us stand tall and straight.
Today we learn how to keep our spine healthy.
Content:
Good posture means sitting and standing straight.
When we lift heavy things we bend our knees.
We should not carry heavy bags on one shoulder.
Back friendly habits help us avoid back pain.
Class activity:
Sit stand and lift well practice.
Children practice proper sitting standing and lifting techniques.
Evaluation questions:
How should we sit?
How should we lift heavy things?
What is good for our spine?
Summary:
Good posture and proper lifting keep our spine healthy.

topics.title: Sleep science
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to explain why sleep is important.
The pupils should be able to list bedtime routines.
Introduction:
Sleep helps us rest after a busy day.
Today we learn about sleep science.
Content:
Our bodies grow when we sleep.
Sleep helps our brain rest and remember things.
Bedtime routines include brushing teeth.
Going to bed at the same time every day is good.
Class activity:
Bedtime routines practice.
Children practice brushing teeth and putting on pajamas.
Evaluation questions:
What happens when we sleep?
Why is sleep important?
What is a good bedtime routine?
Summary:
Sleep helps our bodies grow and our brains rest.

topics.title: Hygiene deep clean
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to list hygiene practices.
The pupils should be able to perform a hygiene audit.
Introduction:
Keeping clean helps us stay healthy.
Today we learn about deep hygiene practices.
Content:
We wash hands with soap before eating.
We brush our teeth twice every day.
We bathe with water every day.
Clean clothes keep us fresh and healthy.
Class activity:
Full hygiene audit.
Children check their hands nails and uniform for cleanliness.
Evaluation questions:
When should we wash our hands?
How many times do we brush teeth?
What keeps us fresh and healthy?
Summary:
Good hygiene practices keep us healthy and clean.

topics.title: First aid basics
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify common injuries.
The pupils should be able to demonstrate first aid steps.
Introduction:
Sometimes we get small injuries at play.
Today we learn basic first aid for common injuries.
Content:
For cuts we wash with clean water.
For burns we run cold water on them.
For nosebleed we sit down and pinch nose.
We always call an adult for help with injuries.
Class activity:
Call for help steps practice.
Children practice telling an adult about an injury.
Evaluation questions:
What do we do for cuts?
What do we do for burns?
What do we do for nosebleed?
Summary:
We know first aid steps for common injuries.

topics.title: Revision and health fair
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to recall health topics.
The pupils should be able to complete health stations.
Introduction:
We have learned many health habits.
Today we practice all we know at the health fair.
Content:
Health stations around the class have different activities.
We visit each station to show what we know.
The health fair passport shows our progress.
We celebrate healthy habits at the end.
Class activity:
Health stations around class.
Children rotate through different health activity stations.
Evaluation questions:
What is one healthy habit you know?
What food group gives us energy?
Why is sleep important?
Summary:
The health fair helps us remember all our health lessons.
